intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Bophut. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Bophut is on the north coast. For strolling, beachfront dinners and the night market stay at Fisherman’s Village; for a quiet family beach choose Bophut Beach; to be near the airport and ferry piers pick Bangrak (Big Buddha); and for quiet luxury with sea views, Plai Laem.

faq.q: What is at Bophut’s Fisherman’s Village?
faq.a: It is an old strip of Sino-Chinese shophouses on Bophut Beach that you can stroll, with cafés, seafront restaurants, bars and a night market on certain evenings. Stays range from small boutiques to beachfront luxury, ideal for travelers who like an evening walking scene.

faq.q: Is Bophut close to Samui Airport?
faq.a: Yes — the Bophut–Bangrak area is on the north coast, a few minutes from Samui Airport and the piers for Koh Phangan and Koh Tao, handy if you fly in and want to stay nearby or plan to ferry on to other islands.

faq.q: Is Bophut better for families or couples?
faq.a: Both — Bophut Beach is quiet with calm water for families, while Fisherman’s Village and Plai Laem have upscale resorts and a romantic feel for couples, so you can pick a zone to match your style within one area.
